'''Rector Attack of the Executor''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rector]]
* '''Published:''' 8 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Main Corridor|Dagobah-D-executormaincorridor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Main Corridor
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Executor Main Corridor Rector DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Executor attacks rebels in selected regions...trying to improve it and suggestions would be welcomed!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Either to attack in air first or on ground. preferably in space, the deck was designed to do that.
